authoring_rationale: Class C: persistence of a permission grant, engaged; Part D condition (d), with (a). Both variants record the same grant: chosen by the member today, streak visible to members of the evening practice group, switches itself off automatically, may be switched off sooner in Settings. They differ only in the end point: 'until the end of the current season' against 'for the next twelve weeks'. When the current season ends is stated nowhere in the visible evidence, so whether the two end points coincide cannot be determined without importing hidden calendar context. Neither a difference nor an equivalence in how long the visibility lasts is established. Locatable at the 'Lasts:' line against 'It stays on for the next twelve weeks'. Surface varied (record versus warm message with an explanatory aside) so that form tracks nothing. Authored fresh from the public ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 law only; not adapted from or templated on any other case or corpus; no void-attempt material used. Orientation and identity computed mechanically from the final bytes (ADR-0055 decisions 7, 8 and 11); no wording was adjusted for orientation, identity or position.
